hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook implementing a per-pool buyback-and-burn mechanism. On sells of the designated main token, a pot absorbs a portion at the pool's exact execution price (shield, via beforeSwap delta). On buys, pot funds purchase more of the main token and deliver it to a configured recipient or burn address (pump, via afterSwap nested swap). Optionally manages an auto-compounding hook-held LP position whose fees are split between compounding, buyback, and burn.
